Class ExprEval

java.lang.Object
jvmumps.ExprEval
public final class ExprEval extends Object
J1 expression evaluator: M values + ISO arithmetic, concat, compare, logic.

Precedence (high to low), left-associative including ** (C32: 2**3**2 = 64): 

  unary  - + '
  ** * / \ #
  + -
  _
  = < > <= >= [ ] ]] '=
  &
  !

Number display uses M mstr (0.5 -> ".5").
